The Delighted connector is a Fivetran integration that connects with the Delighted platform, which is an online service for collecting and analyzing feedback from customers, employees, partners, and vendors. This connector facilitates the seamless transfer of feedback data from Delighted into a data warehouse or other destination, enabling businesses to perform in-depth data analysis and derive actionable insights.

The Delighted connector supports several advanced features, such as data blocking at both the column and table levels, column hashing, and re-sync capabilities at the connector and table levels. It also allows for API configuration, enabling users to manage their connector settings through Fivetran's REST API. The connector is compatible with both SaaS and Hybrid deployment models, although the Hybrid model requires an Enterprise or Business Critical plan. However, it is important to note that for eNPS survey types, the connector does not sync records in the `PERSON` table due to the anonymity of the responses.

To set up the Delighted connector, users need to obtain an API key from their Delighted account and configure the connector through the Fivetran dashboard or API. The setup process involves specifying the destination schema and entering the API key. Once configured, Fivetran handles the data synchronization, ensuring that feedback data is consistently updated in the user's data warehouse.

# Delighted

[Delighted](https://delighted.com/) is an online solution that enables businesses to gather and measure actionable feedback from customers, employees, partners, and vendors.

---

## Features
| Feature Name | Supported | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) |  |  |
| [History mode](/docs/using-fivetran/features#historymode) |  |  |
| [Custom data](/docs/getting-started/features#customdata) |  |  |
| [Data blocking](/docs/getting-started/features#datablocking) | *check* | Column and table level |
| [Column hashing](/docs/getting-started/features#columnhashing) | *check* |  |
| [Re-sync](/docs/getting-started/features#resync) | *check* | Connector level and table level. A parent table re-sync includes all associated child tables. |
| [API configurable](/docs/getting-started/features#apiconfigurable) | *check* | [API configuration](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#delighted) |
| [Priority-first sync](/docs/getting-started/features#priorityfirstsync) |  |  |
| [Fivetran data models](/docs/getting-started/features#fivetrandatamodels) |  |  |
| [Private networking](/docs/getting-started/features#privatenetworking) |  |  |
| [Authorization via API](/docs/rest-api/getting-started#connectorssupportedbyapiandtheirauthorizationmethods) | *check* |  |

---

## Supported deployment models
We support the [SaaS](/docs/deployment-models/saas-deployment) and [Hybrid](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment) deployment models for the connector.

> NOTE: You *must* have an [Enterprise or Business Critical plan](https://www.fivetran.com/pricing/features) to use the Hybrid Deployment model.

---

## Setup guide
Follow our [step-by-step Delighted setup guide](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted/setup-guide) to connect Delighted with your destination using Fivetran connectors.

---

## Schema information
This schema applies to all Delighted connectors.

[To zoom, open ERD in new window](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1cDQqD44yAFi5WsZp3vsZPgIbw3DD0LTjzL2sZA72wdk)

---

## Sync limitation
For [eNPS survey](https://delighted.com/enps) type, we do not sync records in the `PERSON` table because they are anonymous, and Delighted does not associate the survey response with any contact information.

# Release Notes

---

## December 2024
We have added a new paramater, `password`, to the [REST API configuration](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#delighted).

---

## November 2024
The Delighted connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted/setup-guide).

We have added [table re-sync](/docs/using-fivetran/features#tableresync) support. Previously, we only supported connector-level re-syncs.

> NOTE: Event-based tables and tables with a retention period at the source don't support this feature.

You can now select and deselect tables to be synced on the Schema tab of the connector details page in your Fivetran dashboard.

---

## May 2024
We have renamed the primary key column `tag` of the `RESPONSE_TAG` table to `tags` for connectors created on or after April 26, 2024.

We have made the following changes to the Schema tab for Delighted connectors created on or after April 26, 2024:

* All table names now appear in lowercase.
* We now display all tables in the schema, including the empty tables.
* We no longer support table-level selection or deselection for new Delighted connectors.

---

## May 2022
We have added a new table, `RESPONSE_TAG`, to replace the `PERSON_TAG` table. We now sync the API response tag data to the `RESPONSE_TAG` table. We will discontinue the `PERSON_TAG` table after August 2, 2022. Be sure to update your queries.

---

## January 2022
We have moved the `response_person_properties` column from the `PERSON` table to the `RESPONSE` table.

---

## April 2021
Our Delighted connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

[Read our Delighted connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted).

---

## February 2021
[Delighted](https://delighted.com/) is an online solution that enables businesses to gather and measure actionable feedback from customers, employees, partners, and vendors.

[Read our Delighted connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted).

## Cvent [Lite](/docs/getting-started/glossary#liteconnectors)

      "client_id": "your_cvent_client_id",
      "client_secret": "your_cvent_client_secret",
      "region": "your_cvent_account_region"
   }
}

There are two ways to authorize this connector type:

1. By specifying the values for the following parameter in the `auth` section: `client_access`, `refresh_token`, and `access_token`.
   
   `POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`
   
   ```
   {
      "service": "drift",
      "group_id": "target_group_id",
      "config": {
         "schema": "drift_schema_name",
         "sub_domain": "your_drift_domain_name"
      },
      "auth": {
          "client_access": {
              "client_id": "drift_client_id",
              "client_secret": "drift_client_secret"
          },
          "refresh_token": "my_refresh_token",
          "access_token": "my_access_token"
      }
   }
   
   ```
   #### Auth parameters
   
   | Name | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | `client_id` | Your Drift client ID. |
   | `client_secret` | Your Drift client secret. |
   | `refresh_token` | Your Drift refresh token. |
   | `access_token` | Your Drift access token. |
2. By using the [Connect Card](/docs/rest-api/getting-started/connect-card) or the Fivetran dashboard.

## Drip [Lite](/docs/getting-started/glossary#liteconnectors)
### Request

`POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`

```
{
   "service": "drip",
   "group_id": "target_group_id",
   "config": {
      "schema": "drip_schema_name",
      "api_key": "your_drip_API_token"
   }
}

```
#### Config parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `schema` | The connector schema name has to be unique within the destination. Required for connector creation. |
| `api_key` | Your Drip API Token. |

### Authorization

There are two ways to authorize this connector type:

1. By specifying a value for the `api_token` field in the request.
2. By using the [Connect Card](/docs/rest-api/getting-started/connect-card) or the Fivetran dashboard.

## Dropbox
The following example will allow you to create a new connector without authorization. If you want to authorize your connector during its creation, you should add the `auth` section to the request body and define its parameters or perform other actions depending on the authorization type.

The connector supports two sync strategies:

* [Magic Folder](/docs/connectors/files#magicfolder)
* [Merge Mode](/docs/connectors/files#mergemode)

### Magic Folder Request

`POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`

```
{
    "service": "dropbox",
    "group_id": "target_group_id",
    "config": {
        "schema": "test_dropbox",
        "folder": "folder_url"
    }
}

```
> NOTE: For Magic Folder mode, ensure that the `"schema"` name doesn't contain a `.` If you are switching from Merge mode, don't include a `"table"` name in the `"config"` parameter.

#### Config parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `schema` | The connector schema name has to be unique within the destination. Required for connector creation. |
| `folder` | Your Dropbox Folder URL. |

### Merge Mode Request

To use the Merge Mode sync strategy, specify the `is_single_table_mode` parameter as `true`. If you don't specify the parameter, we will use the default Magic Folder strategy to sync files.

`POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`

```
{
   "service": "dropbox",
   "group_id": "target_group_id",
   "config": {
      "schema": "test_dropbox",
      "table": "dest_table",
      "prefix": "folder_path",
      "pattern": "file_pattern",
      "file_type": "infer",
      "json_delivery_mode": "Packed",
      "compression": "infer",
      "on_error": "fail",
      "append_file_option": "upsert_file",
      "archive_pattern": "regex_pattern",
      "null_sequence": "",
      "delimiter": "|",
      "escape_char": "escape_char",
      "skip_before": "0",
      "skip_after": "0",
      "is_single_table_mode": "true",
      "line_separator": ";"
   }
}

```
#### Config parameters

| Name | Description | Possible Values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` (required) | The connector schema name has to be unique within the destination. |  |
| `table` (required) | The table name within the schema to which the connector will sync the data. |  |
| `prefix` | All files and folders under this folder path will be searched for files to sync. |  |
| `pattern` | All files in your search path matching this regular expression will be synced. |  |
| `file_type` | If your files are saved with improper extensions, you can force them to be synced as the selected file type. | `csv`, `json`, `tsv`, `avro`, `jsonl`, `log`, `parquet`, `xml`, `spreadsheet`, `infer` |
| `json_delivery_mode` | Specifies how Fivetran should handle your JSON data. Default value: `Packed`. | `Packed`, `Unpacked` |
| `compression` | The compression format is used to let Fivetran know that even files without a compression extension should be decompressed using the selected compression format. | `infer`, `uncompressed`, `tar`, `tar_bz2`, `tar_gz` |
| `on_error` | If you know that your files contain some errors, you can choose to have poorly formatted lines skipped. We recommend leaving the value as fail unless you are certain that you have undesirable, malformed data. | `fail`, `skip` |
| `append_file_option` | If you know that the source completely overwrites the same file with new data, you can append the changes instead of upserting based on filename and line number. | `upsert_file`, `append_file` |
| `archive_pattern` | Files inside of compressed archives with filenames matching this regular expression will be synced. |  |
| `null_sequence` | If your CSVs use a special value indicating null, you can specify it here. |  |
| `delimiter` | You can specify the delimiter that your CSVs use here. Fivetran generally tries to infer the delimiter, but in some cases this is impossible. |  |
| `escape_char` | If your CSV generator follows non-standard rules for escaping quotation marks, you can set the escape character here. |  |
| `skip_before` | We will skip over the number of lines specified before syncing data. |  |
| `skip_after` | We will skip over the number of lines specified at the end so as to not introduce aberrant data into your destination. |  |
| `is_single_table_mode` (required as `true`) | Allows the creation of connector using Merge Mode strategy. | `true`, `false` |
| `line_separator` | You can specify the custom line separator for your CSV files. The line separator is used in files to separate one row from the next. |  |

### Authorization

There are two ways to authorize this connector type:

1. By specifying the values for the `client_access` and `refresh_token` parameters in the `auth` section.
   
   `POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`
   
   ```
   {
      "service": "dropbox",
      "group_id": "target_group_id",
      "config": {
          "schema": "test_dropbox",
          "folder": "folder_url"
           },
      "auth": {
          "client_access": {
              "client_id": "my_client_id",
              "client_secret": "my_client_secret"
          },
          "refresh_token": "my_refresh_token"
      }
   }
   
   ```
   #### Auth parameters
   
   | Name | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | `client_id` | `Client ID` of your Dropbox client application. |
   | `client_secret` | `Client Secret` of your Dropbox client application. |
   | `refresh_token` | The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources. |
2. By using the [Connect Card](/docs/rest-api/getting-started/connect-card) or the Fivetran dashboard.

## Dropbox Sign [Lite](/docs/getting-started/glossary#liteconnectors)
### Request

`POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`

```
{
   "service": "dropbox_sign",
   "group_id": "target_group_id",
   "config": {
      "schema": "dropbox_sign_schema_name",
      "api_key": "dropbox_sign_api_key"
   }
}

```
#### Config parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `schema` | The connector schema name has to be unique within the destination. Required for connector creation. |
| `api_key` | Your Dropbox Sign API key. |

### Authorization

There are two ways to authorize this connector type:

1. By specifying the value for the `api_key` field in the request.
2. By using the [Connect Card](/docs/rest-api/getting-started/connect-card) or the Fivetran dashboard.

## DSV [Lite](/docs/getting-started/glossary#liteconnectors)
### Request

`POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`

```
{
   "service": "dropbox_sign",
   "group_id": "dsv",
   "config": {
      "schema": "dsv_schema_name",
      "service_authentication": "service_authentication",
      "subscription_key": "subscription_key"
   }
}

```
#### Config parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `schema` | The connector schema name has to be unique within the destination. Required for connector creation. |
| `service_authentication` | A base64 encoded variant of your `username:password` string. Required for authentication. |
| `subscription_key` | Your DSV subscription key. |

### Authorization

There are two ways to authorize this connector type:

1. By specifying the values for the `service_authentication` and `subscription_key` fields in the request.
2. By using the [Connect Card](/docs/rest-api/getting-started/connect-card) or the Fivetran dashboard.

# February 2021

---

## Dashboard Improvements
We've redesigned the [connector list](https://fivetran.com/dashboard/connectors) to make it easier to find the connector you're looking for, even if you have thousands of connectors. We've enabled searching as well as filtering by status and source type to help you find your way quickly. We've also implemented some significant performance improvements, so the connector list will load quickly.

![fcl](/static-assets-docs/_next/static/media/fcl.da6476af.png)

---

## Fivetran Singapore Servers
We have added new servers in Singapore. We will now sync all Singapore users' data to these servers so that your data remains in the Singapore region.

For more information, see our [data residency documentation](/docs/trust/privacy#fivetrandataresidency).

---

## Magic Folder
We have released the beta version of [Fivetran Magic Folder connectors](/docs/connectors/files#magicfolder). With Magic Folder connectors, you can sync multiple files from your cloud folder as unique tables to your destination. Magic Folder connectors are available for the following sources:

* [Box](/docs/connectors/files/box)
* [Dropbox](/docs/connectors/files/dropbox)
* [Google Drive](/docs/connectors/files/google-drive)

---

## Priority-First Sync
You can now check the [priority-first sync](/docs/using-fivetran/features#priorityfirstsync) progress in your Fivetran dashboard.

If your connector supports priority-first sync, you will see 'Priority-First Sync' displayed as the sync type in the Sync History chart in the dashboard's Status tab when you click the [sync bar](/docs/using-fivetran/fivetran-dashboard#synctroubleshooting) during the [initial sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#initialsync).

![pfs-info](/static-assets-docs/_next/static/media/pfs-info.8c4e1148.png)

Click **View** in the sync info pop-up to check the initial sync progress for each table.

![pfs-details](/static-assets-docs/_next/static/media/pfs-details.8d65f6af.png)

---

## Transformations for dbt Core
### Setup tests

We added setup tests in the dbt Transformations setup form. When you click **Save & Test**, Fivetran checks the credentials and connection to your repository.

Previously, Firetran synced projects immediately after you clicked **Save & Test**. Now Fivetran syncs your project within a few minutes after the setup tests succeed.

---

## New connectors
### Coupa

Coupa is a cloud platform for business spend management.

[Read our Coupa connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/coupa).

### Delighted

[Delighted](https://delighted.com/) is an online solution that enables businesses to gather and measure actionable feedback from customers, employees, partners, and vendors.

[Read our Delighted connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted).

### Pipedrive

Pipedrive is a sales CRM and pipeline management platform.

[Read our Pipedrive connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/pipedrive).

### Sage Intacct

Sage Intacct is a cloud-based financial management and services provider.

[Read our Sage Intacct connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/sage-intacct).

### SurveyMonkey

SurveyMonkey is an online survey development tool to create and run surveys.

[Read our Survey Monkey connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/surveymonkey).

---

## Schema changes
### Eloqua

We now add a prefix, `custom_`, to a custom column name if we find a standard column with the same name in the `FORM_SUBMISSION` table.

If your `FORM_SUBMISSION` table contains custom columns and standard columns with the same names, [contact support](https://support.fivetran.com/hc/en-us) to re-sync your `FORM_SUBMISSION` table. See [our Eloqua ERD](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1bOj0F8UBSNgPusXjc1fuooW2VvgY-RppPpSI-1nfLvM/edit) for more information on the standard columns in the `FORM_SUBMISSION` table.

### HubSpot

We have added a new column, `meeting_outcome`, to the `ENGAGEMENT_MEETING` table.

We have added a new column, `is_merged`, to the `DEAL` table to track merged deals. If you'd like to sync historical data for this column, re-sync the `DEAL` table.

### Iterable

We have added a new column, `email_list_ids`, to the `USER_HISTORY` table. The `email_list_ids` column stores details of all the lists (an array of all the List IDs) that a user is subscribed to.

### Jira

We now support the `Satisfaction` and `Satisfaction date` fields of Jira Service Management (formerly Jira Service Desk).

### Lever

We have added a new table, `POSTING_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL`, which contains your postings' distribution channel information. The `POSTING_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL` table is a child table of the `POSTING` table.

### Mailchimp

We have added two new columns, `source` and `unsubscribe_reason`, to the `MEMBER` table.

If you'd like to sync your historical data from the `source` and `unsubscribe_reason` columns, [contact our support team](https://support.fivetran.com/).

### Recharge

We have added the following new columns to the `CUSTOMER` table:

* `first_charge_processed_at`
* `number_active_subscriptions`
* `number_subscriptions`

### Salesforce

We now sync the following system tables by default and have removed them from the **Schema** tab on your connector details page:

* `FIVETRAN_API_CALL`
* `FIVETRAN_QUERY`
* `FIVETRAN_FORMULA`
* `FIVETRAN_FORMULA_HISTORY`

### Shopify

We have added the following new columns to the `FULFILLMENT` table:

* `shipment_status`
* `tracking_numbers`
* `tracking_urls`

We have added the following new columns to the `FULFILLMENT_ORDER_LINE` table:

* `order_id`
* `product_id`
* `variant_id`
* `fulfillable_quantity`
* `fulfillment_service`
* `gift_card`
* `grams`
* `name`
* `price_set`
* `price`
* `properties`
* `quantity`
* `requires_shipping`
* `sku`
* `taxable`
* `title`
* `variant_title`
* `vendor`

### Stripe

We have added a new field, `calculated_statement_descriptor`, to the `CHARGE` table.

We have added the following new fields to the `INVOICE` table:

* `status_transitions_finalized_at`
* `status_transitions_marked_uncollectible_at`
* `status_transitions_paid_at`
* `status_transitions_voided_at`

---

## Improvements
### Adobe Analytics

The Adobe Analytics connector now allows you to create and sync data from multiple configurations. See our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/adobe-analytics/setup-guide) for more details.

New connectors created after February 9, 2021, will support this new functionality by default.

### Apache Kafka

We have added support for Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) authentication with `SCRAM-SHA-512`.

### AWS CloudTrail

Our AWS CloudTrail connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

[Read our AWS CloudTrail connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/aws-cloudtrail).

### AWS Inventory

Our AWS Inventory connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

[Read our AWS Inventory connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/aws-inventory).

### Azure Database for MySQL

Our Azure Database for MySQL connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

See our [Azure Database for MySQL setup instructions](/docs/connectors/databases/mysql/azure-setup-guide).

### Azure Monitor

Our Azure Monitor log service is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

[Read our Azure Monitor documentation](/docs/logs/external-logs/azure-monitor).

### Campaign Manager

Now you can select Custom Floodlight variables in the `PATH_TO_CONVERSION` reports.

### GitHub

We can now sync commits from deleted branches that were associated with pull requests. We are gradually rolling out this improvement to all existing connectors. If you have missing commits in your destination, re-sync your connector.

### Mandrill

We have fixed a bug where the Mandrill server was sending email events data with an invalid TIMESTAMP value with extra digits appended to it. We now consider the first ten digits and discard the extra digits to get the actual TIMESTAMP value.

### Pardot

The Pardot connector now supports authorization using [Salesforce OAuth](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/pardot/guide/authentication.html). You can now authenticate with an SSO-enabled user account. See our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/pardot/setup-guide) for more details.

New connectors created after February 16, 2021, will support this new functionality by default.

### Salesforce

We now support [custom metadata type objects](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_custommetadatatype__mdt.htm). We are gradually rolling out this new feature to all existing connectors. If you'd like to enable this feature on your connector, [contact our support team](https://fivetran.com/support).

### Snowflake

We have added a new optional field **Role** to the Snowflake destination setup form. If you want Fivetran to use a role other than your default role, enter the role’s name during the destination setup in the **Role** field. See [our setup instructions](/docs/destinations/snowflake/setup-guide#completefivetranconfiguration) for more information.

### SQL Server

We can now sync tables that do not have all of their columns included in their CDC instances. For these tables, we only sync the columns that are present in the CDC instance. To include excluded columns, delete your old CDC instance and create a new one that includes all columns.

This improvement is applicable for the following SQL Server connectors:

* Generic SQL Server
* Amazon RDS for SQL Server
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure SQL Managed Instance

### Twitter Ads

We now support syncing data for the `media_creative` entity. See our [MEDIA CREATIVE table documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/twitter-ads#mediacreativetable) for more information.

### Zendesk Sunshine

Our Zendesk Sunshine connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases). [Read our Zendesk Sunshine connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/zendesk-sunshine).

We have added a new connector setup test to check if you have enabled the Events API in your account. See [Zendesk's Events API documentation](https://develop.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043673994-About-the-Sunshine-Events-API#reqs) for more information.

---

## REST API Improvements
### Jira

Our Jira connector no longer uses the `use_webhooks` configuration field.

# May 2024

## Improvements
### AppsFlyer

We now perform [rollback syncs](/docs/getting-started/glossary#rollbacksync) for the `GEO_DAILY` table to capture the latest [Lifetime Value (LVT)](https://www.appsflyer.com/glossary/ltv/) records that change due to attribution. The default rollback window is 2 days. However, you can customize your rollback window within the range of 2 to 90 days. To support this enhancement, we have added a new field, **Rollback Window**, to the connector setup form. For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/appsflyer/setup-guide).

### Attentive

We have changed the connector type of our Attentive connector from Lite to Standard.

### Azure Blob Storage

We have added a new configuration option, **Primary Key used for file process and load**, in the connector setup form to support syncing files with custom primary keys. You can now select the custom primary keys during the connector configuration and use them to update or insert new rows in your destination. We process the most recently modified files to your destination. For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/files/azure-blob-storage#upsertwithcustomprimarykeys).

### Azure Data Lake Storage

We now perform regular maintenance operations on the tables in your Azure Data Lake Storage destination. These maintenance operations do the following:

* Delete the table snapshots that are older than 7 days
* Clean up orphan and removed files

For more information, see [our Azure Data Lake Storage documentation](/docs/destinations/azure-data-lake-storage#tablemaintenanceoperations). We are gradually rolling out this enhancement to all existing destinations.

### BigQuery

We support syncing data from tables and views from [Analytics Hub linked datasets](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/analytics-hub-introduction), which do not have the [data egress restriction](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/analytics-hub-introduction#data_egress).

### Care Quality Commission

We have made the following changes to our Care Quality Commission connector to support the recent [Care Quality Commission API changes](https://www.cqc.org.uk/about-us/transparency/using-cqc-data#api):

* In the connector setup form, we replaced the **Partner code** field with the **Primary key** field. For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/care-quality-commission/setup-guide).
* In the API config parameters, we replaced the `partner_code` parameter with the `primary_key` parameter. For more information, see our [REST API documentation](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#carequalitycommission).

### Churnzero

We no longer [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) for the following tables and their child tables:

* `ACCOUNT`
* `CONTACT`
* `EVENT`
* `JOURNEY`
* `JOURNEY_INSTANCE`
* `JOURNEY_MILESTONE`
* `JOURNEY_MILESTONE_ACHIEVEMENT`
* `JOURNEY_MILESTONE_PROGRESS`
* `JOURNEY_MILESTONE_STEP_PROGRESS`
* `JOURNEY_MILESTONE_TASK`
* `JOURNEY_PROGRESS`
* `SEGMENT`
* `SEGMENT_COLUMN_SET`
* `SURVEY_RESPONSE`
* `TASK`
* `USER_ACCOUNT`

### Cin7 Core

We have renamed our DEAR connector to Cin7 Core. This name change applies to the Fivetran dashboard and [our documentation](https://fivetran.com/docs).

### Cvent

We have changed the sync strategy for the `ATTENDEE_ACTIVITY` table. We no longer re-import the `ATTENDEE_ACTIVITY` table to capture updates and deletes.

### Delighted

We have made the following changes to the Schema tab for Delighted connectors created on or after April 26, 2024:

* All table names now appear in lowercase.
* We now display all tables in the schema, including the empty tables.
* We no longer support table-level selection or deselection for new Delighted connectors.

### Drip

We no longer [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport) the following tables and their child tables to [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes):

* `CONVERSATION`
* `EMAIL_SERIES_CAMPAIGN`
* `EMAIL_SERIES_SUBSCRIBER_ACTIVE`
* `EMAIL_SERIES_SUBSCRIBER_REMOVED`
* `EMAIL_SERIES_SUBSCRIBER_UNSUBSCRIBED`
* `PEOPLE`
* `SINGLE_EMAIL_CAMPAIGN`
* `WORKFLOW`

### Dropbox

Our Dropbox connector now supports syncing Microsoft Excel spreadsheets in [Merge Mode](/docs/connectors/files/dropbox#mergemode). For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/files/dropbox/setup-guide#mergemode).

### Eventbrite

We have changed our sync strategy and no longer [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) for the following tables and their child tables:

* `ATTENDEE`
* `ORDERS`

### Facebook Ads

We now support the new `Engaged-view` attribution window with a `1 day` value. This window refers to engaged-view conversions that are counted when a skippable video ad is played for at least 10 seconds *or* at least 97% of its total length if it’s shorter than 10 seconds, then a person takes an action within one day.

Learn more in Facebook's [Engaged-view documentation](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/1055388958765938) and [Graph API parameters documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/adgroup/insights/v19.0#parameters).

### Firebase

Support for non-default Firebase databases is now generally available for the Firebase connector. Previously, this feature was only available upon request.

Learn more about multiple databases (the default database + non-default databases) in Google's [Firestore Multiple Databases is now generally available article](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/databases/firestore-multiple-databases-is-now-generally-available).

### Fivetran Platform Connector

The Fivetran Platform connector now syncs 7 days' worth of historical data instead of 5 days.

You now can select tables to be included in or excluded from syncs on the **Schema** tab of the Fivetran Platform Connector details page.

We are gradually rolling out these changes to all existing connectors.

### Google Analytics 4

Google Analytics 4 now supports [aggregation by time unit dimensions](/docs/connectors/applications/google-analytics-4/custom-reports#aggregationlevels).

### Insightly

We now [incrementally sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#incrementalsync) the following tables and their child tables:

* `OPPORTUNITY_ITEM`
* `ORGANISATION`

* `PRICE_BOOK`

* `PRODUCT`

* `USERS`

### Instagram Business

We have added data that represents comments on [IG Media](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api/reference/ig-media) to our Instagram Business connector. For more information, see [Graph API's IG Comment](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api/reference/ig-comment).

### Klaviyo

We can now pack all the custom fields for the `EVENT` and `PERSON` tables into a single JSON file and upsert it into a single column. We have added a new field, **Pack Mode**, to the connector setup form. The field provides you the option to choose how Fivetran should handle your custom fields. For more information, see [our Klaviyo connector documentation](/docs/applications/klaviyo).

### Mambu

We no longer [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport) the `CENTRE` table and its child tables.

### Maxio Chargify

We now [incrementally sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#incrementalsync) the `COMPONENT` table and its child tables to capture new records.

We now also [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) for the `COMPONENT` table.

### MySQL

Our [GTID replication mode](/docs/connectors/databases/mysql#gtidmode) is now generally available.

### NetSuite SuiteAnalytics

We have fixed a bug where we didn’t sync some records for the `PREVIOUS_TRANSACTION_LINE_LINK` table. We have added the `_fivetran_index` column as a primary key column to the `PREVIOUS_TRANSACTION_LINE_LINK` table.

### OneLake

We now perform regular maintenance operations on the tables in your OneLake destination. These maintenance operations do the following:

* Delete the table snapshots that are older than 7 days
* Clean up orphan and removed files

For more information, see [our OneLake documentation](/docs/destinations/onelake#tablemaintenanceoperations). We are gradually rolling out this enhancement to all existing destinations.

### Prive

We no longer [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) for the following tables:

* `BILLING_ATTEMPT`
* `ORDER_LINE_ITEM`
* `PRODUCT`
* `SUBSCRIBER`
* `SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVITY`

### Qualtrics

The Qualtrics connector now supports [OAuth 2.0 authentication](/docs/applications/qualtrics#oauth20authentication). Qualtrics connectors created on or after May 21, 2024, use OAuth 2.0-based authentication. For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/applications/qualtrics/setup-guide).

You can migrate your existing connectors from API key-based authentication to OAuth authentication. For more information, see our [migration instructions](/docs/applications/qualtrics/setup-guide#migratetooauthauthentication).

We are gradually rolling out this feature to all existing connectors.

### Salesforce

We now translate formulas containing the `/` operator only for the following destinations:

* BigQuery
* Databricks
* PostgreSQL
* Redshift
* Snowflake

Previously, we supported this operator for all destinations.

### Salesforce Commerce Cloud

We now [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) for the following tables:

* `CATALOG`
* `CATEGORY`
* `SHARED_PRODUCT_OPTION`
* `SHARED_PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE`
* `GIFT_CERTIFICATE`
* `GIFT_CERTIFICATE_TRANSACTION`
* `PROMOTION`
* `COUPON`
* `SOURCE_CODE_GROUP`
* `CUSTOMER_GROUP`
* `CUSTOM_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_DEFINITION`
* `CUSTOM_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP`
* `STORE`
* `INVENTORY_LIST`
* `INVENTORY_LIST_RECORD`

### Salesloft

We can now sync the email templates used in [Salesloft Cadences](https://help.salesloft.com/s/article/What-Is-a-Cadence) into the `EMAIL_TEMPLATES` table. To backfill the historical data for this type of email templates, [re-sync](/docs/using-fivetran/features#tableresync) the `EMAIL_TEMPLATES` table.

### SharePoint

Our SharePoint connector now supports syncing Microsoft Excel spreadsheets in [Merge Mode](/docs/files/share-point#mergemode). For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/files/share-point#syncingspreadsheets).

### Spotify Ads

We now support the [Spotify Ads API v2](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ads-api#release-notes) with all updates made to it through March 2024.

### Sprout Social

Our Sprout Social connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases). [Read our Sprout Social connector documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/sprout-social).

### Square

The Square connector now supports [table blocking](/docs/getting-started/feature#datablocking) for all Square tables. You can choose which tables to sync and which to block from syncing to your destination. On your Connector Details page, go to the **Schema** tab and select or deselect the tables.

If you want to sync a child table, you must include its parent table for the sync.

### Vitally

We have added a new field, **Base URL**, to the setup form. For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/vitally/setup-guide).

### Workday HCM

We now support OAuth authentication to connect to Workday HCM.

### Wrike

We no longer perform a weekly re-import of the `FOLDER_PROJECT` and `TASK` tables.

### Zoho CRM

You can now select the child tables (including subforms) to sync from the **Schema** tab on your connector details page. To backfill the historical data for a child table that you select, [re-sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#resync) its parent table. We will backfill the historical data for the subforms during their weekly [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport).

We now [create empty tables and columns](/docs/using-fivetran/features#syncingemptytablesandcolumns) in your destination for the child tables that do not have any data.

You can now track the history of your deal stages. To facilitate this enhancement, we have added the following new tables:

* `STAGE`
* A new child table, `DEAL_STAGE_HISTORY`, to the `DEAL` table

We are gradually rolling out this enhancement to all existing connectors.

---

## REST API Improvements
### Create a Connector Schema Config endpoint

Our [Connector Management API](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connectors) now supports a new endpoint, [`Create a Connector Schema Config`](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connector-schema/pre-create-connector-schema-config). The endpoint allows to configure the schema before the initial sync without reloading. The endpoint is not in [beta](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

### Proxy Agent and Private Link Management-related changes in the REST API

To [Create a Private Link](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/private-links/create-private-link) using our [Private Link Management API](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/private-links), you now must specify the `service` and `region` parameter values in the request instead of `group_id`. This enables you to use a single private link for all destinations with the same service and region.

To [Create a Proxy Agent](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/proxy-agent/create-proxy-agent) using our [Proxy Agent Management API](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/proxy-agent), you now must specify the `group_region` parameter value in the request instead of `group_id`. This enables you to use a single proxy agents for all connections in a specified region.

We have added the following parameters in the [Connection Management API](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connectors):

* `proxy_agent_id` - defines the proxy ID
* `private_link_id` - defines the private link ID.
* `networking_method` - defines the connection method. Possible values are as follows:
  + `Directly` - direct connection
  + `PrivateLink` - connection via private link
  + `ProxyAgent` - connection via proxy
  + `SshTunnel` - connection via SSH Tunnel.

We have added the following parameters in the [Destination Management API](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/destinations):

* `private_link_id` - defines the private link ID.
* `networking_method` - defines the connection method. Possible values are as follows:
  + `Directly` - direct connection
  + `PrivateLink` - connection via private link
  + `SshTunnel` - connection via SSH Tunnel.

* `complete_listing`: The default listing strategy where we list all the files in the bucket and filter new and modified files.
* `time_based_pattern_listing`: An optimized listing strategy to improve sync speeds. We fetch the files in a lexicographic order starting from the last file of the previous sync. You can opt to use this strategy if your files are named based on the date or time they are added to the bucket. For example, if a time-based pattern exists in the bucket leading to every new file being appended in a lexicographically increasing order:
  
  | Filename | Last Modified |
  | --- | --- |
  | 2021/01/01.csv | January 1, 2021 |
  | 2021/01/02.csv | January 2, 2021 |
  | 2021/01/03.csv | January 3, 2021 |
  | 2021/01/04.csv | January 4, 2021 |

We have added a schema filter to our [List All Connectors within a Group endpoint](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/groups/list-all-connectors-in-group). Specify the schema of a connector as a value of the `schema` GET parameter to perform filtering and retrieve only information for that connector.

# November 2024

## Improvements
### Adyen

We have resolved an issue where the `raw_acquirer_response` column in the `RECEIVED_PAYMENTS_REPORT` table was not replicating.

Re-sync the table to update and populate the existing null values in your destination.

### Aha!

We now [incrementally sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#incrementalsync) the `RELEASE` table.

### Amazon S3

We have improved the connector setup experience and made the following changes to the connector setup form:

* Added a new configuration option, **Run connection test** to perform an intermediate test during configuration
* Added a new configuration option, **Preview Files** to perform an intermediate test during configuration
* Added support for displaying fields based on the file type
* Added a new field, **Quote character**, to use an enclosing character
* Reorganised fields to make the setup form more intuitive
* Removed **Infer** as an option from the **File Type** field
* Removed the **Enable Advanced Options** toggle
* Changed the **Null Sequence** field to a toggle
* For the **Delimiter** field, we now use `,` as the default value
* For the **Line Separator** field, we now use `\n` as the default value

For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/files/amazon-s3/setup-guide-new). We are gradually rolling out these changes to all existing connectors.

### Assembled

The Assembled connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/assembled/setup-guide).

### Azure Blob Storage

The Azure Blob Storage connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/files/azure-blob-storage/setup-guide).

### Azure DevOps

The Azure DevOps connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/azure-devops/setup-guide).

### Azure Event Hubs

The Azure Event Hubs connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/events/azure-event-hubs/setup-guide).

### Azure SQL Database

Azure SQL Database connectors configured for [Hybrid Deployment](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment) now support Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) authentication.

### Collibra

We have updated our sync strategy. We now re-import the `ATTRIBUTE` table once a month and no longer re-import the `JOB` table. Previously, we re-imported these two tables weekly.

### commercetools

The commercetools connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/commercetools/setup-guide).

### Coupa

We have updated our sync strategy for the `COMMODITY` table. We now sync the table data using the `commodities` API endpoint.

### Delighted

The Delighted connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted/setup-guide).

We have added [table re-sync](/docs/using-fivetran/features#tableresync) support. Previously, we only supported connector-level re-syncs.

> NOTE: Event-based tables and tables with a retention period at the source don't support this feature.

You can now select and deselect tables to be synced on the Schema tab of the connector details page in your Fivetran dashboard.

### Factbird

We can now sync data from Factbird accounts with custom base URLs. To support this enhancement, we have made the following changes to the connector setup form:

* Added a new drop-down menu, **Base URL**, where you can select whether your account uses the default or a custom base URL
* Added the **Custom base URL** field for specifying your custom base URL

For more information, see [our setup guide](/docs/connectors/applications/factbird/setup-guide).

### FreshTeam

We have added [table re-sync](/docs/using-fivetran/features#tableresync) support. Previously, we only supported connector-level re-syncs.

> NOTE: Event-based tables and tables with a retention period at the source don't support this feature.

### Gainsight Customer Success

The Gainsight Customer Success connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/gainsight-customer-success/setup-guide).

### Google Ads

The Google Ads connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/google-ads/setup-guide).

### Google Search Ads 360

We've added the following metadata tables to provide a more comprehensive schema:

* `ad`
* `ad_group`
* `bidding_strategy`
* `campaign`
* `customer`

We've added the following prebuilt reports to our Google Search Ads 360 connector:

* `ad_conversion_action_and_device_report`
* `ad_device_report`
* `ad_group_conversion_action_and_device_report`
* `ad_group_device_report`
* `ad_group_report`
* `campaign_conversion_action_and_device_report`
* `campaign_device_report`
* `campaign_report`
* `customer_conversion_action_and_device_report`
* `customer_device_report`
* `customer_report`
* `keyword_conversion_action_and_device_report`
* `keyword_device_report`
* `keyword_report`

Prebuilt reports are common report configurations that make it easier to get insight into your data without needing to create custom reports. For more details about this update, please refer to the [Google Search Ads 360 ERD](https://fivetran.com/connector-erd/google_search_ads_360).

### History mode support

[History mode](/docs/core-concepts/sync-modes/history-mode) is now in beta for the following destinations:

* [Azure Data Lake Storage](/docs/destinations/azure-data-lake-storage)
* [OneLake](/docs/destinations/onelake)
* [S3 Data Lake](/docs/destinations/s3-data-lake)

### HubSpot

We have added support for [HubSpot's Feedback Submissions API](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/objects/feedback-submissions) to sync the feedback submissions data in your HubSpot account. We are gradually rolling out this improvement to all existing connectors.

### Impact

The Impact connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/impact/setup-guide).

### Ironclad

The Ironclad connector now supports [OAuth 2.0 authentication](https://support.ironcladapp.com/hc/en-us/articles/20448750509335-OAuth-2-0-Overview). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/ironclad/setup-guide).

### Lever

The Lever connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/lever/setup-guide).

### Maxio SaaSOptics

We now [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport) the `INVOICE` table once a week to capture updates and deletes.

We now [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport) the `TRANSACTION` table once a day to capture updates and deletes. Previously, we only supported incremental sync for this table.

### MongoDB

If your MongoDB server version is less than 4.0, you must upgrade to a supported version by March 1, 2025. Otherwise, the MongoDB drivers will no longer be compatible with your server version. Learn more in MongoDB's [MongoDB's software lifecycle schedules documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/legal/support-policy/lifecycles).

### Navan

We now capture fixed-scale decimals for all columns containing financial data.

### NetSuite SuiteAnalytics

The NetSuite SuiteAnalytics connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/netsuite-suiteanalytics/setup-guide).

### OneLake

We have introduced new fields in the setup form: Workspace GUID and Lakehouse GUID.

For new connectors, these fields now replace the existing Workspace Name and Lakehouse Name fields.

For existing connectors, the new GUID fields have been added alongside the current Workspace Name and Lakehouse Name fields. We will sunset the original fields in a future update. Ensure that you update the new GUID fields before this change.

### PayPal

The PayPal connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/paypal/setup-guide).

### PostgreSQL

We now support syncing the "oid" data type as LONG. See all supported data types in [our PostgreSQL documentation](/docs/connectors/databases/postgresql#typetransformationandmapping).

### PostgreSQL destination

All [PostgreSQL implementations](/docs/destinations/postgresql#supportedimplementations) now support the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). We are gradually rolling out this feature to all existing destinations. For more information, see the individual destination setup guides.

### Recurly

The Recurly connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/recurly/setup-guide).

### Salesforce

For roll-up summary fields that reference formula fields, we now round formula field values to their configured scale before calculating the roll-up summary result, aligning with Salesforce behavior. This improvement applies to BigQuery, Databricks, PostgreSQL, Redshift, and Snowflake destinations. For other destinations, we calculate the roll-up summary result without rounding.

We are gradually rolling out this change to all existing connectors.

### SAP Concur

We have added a new field, **Historical Sync Limit**, to the connector setup form. This allows you to select a date to limit the historical data sync to. The historical sync limit applies to all incremental tables. This change applies to all new and existing connectors. For an existing connector, you can edit the connection details and select a date. We have also added support for the `historical_sync_limit` field for connectors created using the [Create a Connector endpoint](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connectors/create-connector). For more information, see our [REST API config](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#sapconcur).

> NOTE: Updating the value of the **Historical Sync Limit** may trigger a complete connector resync.

We are gradually rolling out this feature to all connectors.

### Sentry

The Sentry connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/sentry/setup-guide).

### ServiceNow

We have added support for Okta authentication. We will be gradually rolling out this feature to existing connections.

### SFTP

We have improved the connector setup experience and made the following changes to the connector setup form:

* Added a new configuration option, **Preview Files**, to perform an intermediate test during configuration
* Added support for displaying fields based on the file type
* Added a new field, **Quote character**, to use an enclosing character
* Reorganised fields to make the setup form more intuitive
* Removed **Infer** as an option from the **File Type** field
* Removed the **Enable Advanced Options** toggle
* Changed the **Null Sequence** field to a toggle
* For the **Delimiter character(s)** field, we now use `,` as the default value
* For the **Line Separator** field, we now use `\n` as the default value

For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/files/sftp/setup-guide) and [REST API configuration](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#sftp). We are gradually rolling out these changes to all existing connectors.

### SharePoint

The SharePoint connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/files/share-point/setup-guide).

### Shopify

We have fixed a data integrity issue in the `currency` column of the `CUSTOMER` table. If you observe `null` values for the column in your destination, trigger a re-sync of the `CUSTOMER` table.

### Slack

The Slack connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/slack/setup-guide).

### Snowflake

We now support IAM role authentication to authorize S3 buckets associated with Snowflake destinations configured for the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment).

### Spotify Ads

Our Spotify Ads connector is now [generally available](/docs/core-concepts#releasephases).

[Read our Spotify Ads connector documentation.](/docs/connectors/applications/spotify-ads)

### Sprout Social

The Sprout Social connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/sprout-social/setup-guide).

### StackAdapt

We now [capture deletes](/docs/using-fivetran/features#capturedeletes) only for the following tables:

* `ADVERTISER`
* `AUDIENCE`
* `CAMPAIGN`
* `CAMPAIGN_GROUP`
* `CONVERSION_TRACKER`
* `CREATIVE`
* `CUSTOM_SEGMENT_OPTION`
* `DEAL_GROUP`
* `RETARGETING_AUDIENCE`
* `SUPPLY_SOURCE_OPTION`

Previously, we captured deletes for all the tables.

We have made the following changes to the sync strategy:

* We now [incrementally sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#incrementalsync) the following tables and their child tables to capture new records:
  
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_AUDIENCE`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_AUDIENCE_AB`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_BID_FACTOR`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_CREATIVE_TACTIC`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_DEAL`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_DEMOGRAPHIC`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_DEVICE`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GEO`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_AUDIENCE`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_AUDIENCE_AB`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_BID_FACTOR`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_CATEGORY`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_CREATIVE_TACTIC`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_DEAL`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_DEMOGRAPHIC`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_DEVICE`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_GEO`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_RETARGETING_SEGMENT`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_GROUP_SUPPLY_SOURCE`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_RETARGETING_SEGMENT`
  + `INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN_SUPPLY_SOURCE`
  + `STATS_DELIVERY_ADVERTISER`
  + `STATS_DELIVERY_CAMPAIGN`
  + `STATS_DELIVERY_CAMPAIGN_GROUP`
  + `STATS_DELIVERY_CONVERSION_TRACKER`
  + `STATS_DELIVERY_NATIVE_AD`
* We now [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport) the remaining tables and their child tables during every sync to capture updates and deletes.

### StarRez

The StarRez connector now supports priority-first sync. Priority-first syncs fetch your most recent data first so that it's quickly ready for you to use. StarRez's priority-first syncs fetch the most recent 15 days' worth of data from all tables except the following tables:

* `BOOKING_TYPE`
* `CUSTOM_FIELD_USAGE_TYPE_ENUM`
* `ENROLLMENT_TYPE_ENUM`
* `ENTRY_STATUS_ENUM`
* `FIELD_DATA_TYPE_ENUM`
* `GENDER_ENUM`
* `GL_POSTING_TYPE_ENUM`
* `GROUP_STATUS_ENUM`
* `NATIONALITY`
* `ROOM_RATE_DURATION_ENUM`
* `ROOM_SPACE_TYPE_ENUM`
* `ROOMSPACE_CLOSED_REASON`
* `TRANSACTION_TYPE_ENUM`

To learn more, see our [priority-first sync documentation](/docs/using-fivetran/features#priorityfirstsync).

### Talkdesk

The Talkdesk connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/talkdesk/setup-guide).

### Teamwork

We no longer [re-import](/docs/getting-started/glossary#reimport) the `CALENDAR_EVENT`, `PROJECT_BUDGET`,`TIME_TRACKING`, and `USERS` tables and its child tables once a week.

We [incrementally sync](/docs/getting-started/glossary#incrementalsync) the `ACTIVITY`, `CALENDAR_EVENT`, `TASK`, and `TIME_TRACKING` tables based on the updated timestamp.

### Transcend

We can now sync data from Transcend accounts hosted in the US region. To support this enhancement, we have added a new drop-down menu, **Region**, to the connector setup form. For more information, see [our setup guide](/docs/connectors/applications/transcend/setup-guide).

### Uservoice

The Uservoice connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/uservoice/setup-guide).

### Workday RaaS

If a selected primary key contains a null value in your reports, we display a warning on the connector dashboard and insert the record with a `null` value in your destination. If the destination does not support null values, we insert the row with the default value for the column instead.

### Xero

We have improved the decimal precision of the `currency_rate` columns and now support a scale of 10 for decimal values in the `currency_rate` columns of the following tables:

* `BANK_TRANSACTION`
* `BANK_TRANSFER`
* `CREDIT_NOTE`
* `INVOICE`
* `OVERPAYMENT`
* `PAYMENT`
* `PREPAYMENT`

Previously, we supported a scale of 6 for decimal values and rounded the values to six decimal places.

### Yahoo Search Ads Yahoo Japan

We have upgraded our Yahoo Search Ads Yahoo Japan connector to Search Ads API v15 from v12.

### Zendesk Chat

The Zendesk Chat connector now supports the [Hybrid Deployment model](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment). For more information, see [our setup instructions](/docs/connectors/applications/zendesk-chat/setup-guide).

### Zendesk Support

We have added a new field, **Historical sync time frame**, to the connector setup form. This allows you to select how many months' worth of historical data you want to sync. For an existing connector, you can edit the connection details and set the time frame value. For more information, see our [Historical sync time frame documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/zendesk#historicalsynctimeframe).

We apply the historical sync limit to the following tables only:

* `SATISFACTION_RATING`
* `TICKET`
* `TICKET_TAG`
* `TICKET_FIELD`

We are gradually rolling out this feature to all connectors.

---

### New Log Service Management endpoint to list logging services within account

We have implemented a new Log Service Management API endpoint for our [REST API](/docs/rest-api). You can now leverage the new [List all logging services within account](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/log-service-management) feature.

## Adjust
The following example will allow you to create a new connector without authorization. If you want to authorize your connector during its creation, you should add the `auth` section to the request body and define its parameters or perform other actions depending on the authorization type.

### Request

`POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`

```
{
    "service": "adjust",
    "group_id": "target_group_id",
    "config": {
        "schema": "adjust"
    }
}

```
#### Config parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `schema` | The connector schema name has to be unique within the destination. Required for connector creation. |

### Authorization

There are two ways to authorize this connector type:

1. By specifying the values for `csv_definition`, `export_storage_type`, `bucket_name`, and `s3_role_arn` (optional) in the `auth` section.
   
   `POST https://api.fivetran.com/v1/connectors`
   
   ```
    {
     "service": "adjust",
         "group_id": "target_group_id",
         "config": {
             "schema": "adjust"           
          },
       "auth": {
          "csv_definition" : "my export definition",
          "export_storage_type" : "AWS_S3 or GCS",
          "bucket_name": "bucket",
          "s3_role_arn" : "role_arn"
         }
    }
   
   ```
   #### Auth parameters
   
   | Name | Description | Possible Values |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | `csv_definition` | CSV definition for the CSV export (https://help.adjust.com/en/article/csv-uploads#how-do-i-format-my-csv-definition). |  |
   | `export_storage_type` | Your cloud storage. | `GCS`, `AWS_S3` |
   | `bucket_name` | Your AWS S3 or GCS bucket. |  |
   | `s3_role_arn` | Used if the `export_storage_type` is `AWS_S3`, the Role ARN required for authentication. |  |
   
   > NOTE: If `export_storage_type` is `GCS` is, then you will need to grant Fivetran access to your Google Cloud Storage bucket.
2. By using the [Connect Card](/docs/rest-api/getting-started/connect-card) or the Fivetran dashboard.

# Delighted Setup Guide

Follow our setup guide to connect Delighted to Fivetran.

---

## Prerequisites
To connect Delighted to Fivetran, you need a [Delighted](https://delighted.com/) account.

---

## Setup instructions
### Find API key

1. Log in to your [Delighted account](https://app.delighted.com/signin).
2. Navigate to the [API documentation page](https://app.delighted.com/docs/api).
3. In the **Authentication** section, find your API key and make a note of it. You will need it to configure Fivetran.
   
   ![copy_api_key](/static-assets-docs/_next/static/media/delighted_api_key.bdbd82ba.png)
   
   > If you don't have the API key, contact your account admin to obtain the key.

### Finish Fivetran configuration

1. In the [connector setup form](/docs/using-fivetran/fivetran-dashboard/connectors#addanewconnector), enter the **Destination schema** name of your choice.
2. Enter the **API Key** you found in [Step 1](/docs/connectors/applications/delighted/setup-guide#findapikey).
3. ([Hybrid Deployment](/docs/deployment-models/hybrid-deployment) only) If your destination is configured for Hybrid Deployment, the Hybrid Deployment Agent associated with your destination is pre-selected in the **Select an existing agent** drop-down menu. To use a different agent, select the agent of your choice, and then select the same agent for your destination.
4. Click **Save & Test**. Fivetran will take it from here and sync your Delighted data.

## Improvements
### Adyen

Our Adyen connector is now [generally available](/docs/getting-started/core-concepts#releasephases). [Read our Adyen documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/adyen).

### Affinity

We have added [table re-sync](/docs/using-fivetran/features#tableresync) support. Previously, we only supported connector-level re-syncs.

> NOTE: Event-based tables and tables with a retention period at the source don't support this feature.

You can now select and deselect tables to be synced on the Schema tab of the connector details page in your Fivetran dashboard.

### Azure Blob Storage

We have improved the setup experience for Azure Blob Storage connectors. New connectors created on or after December 20, 2024, will have the following changes in the connector setup form:

* Added a new configuration option, **Run connection test** to perform an intermediate test during configuration
* Added a new configuration option, **Preview Files**, to perform an intermediate test during configuration
* Added support for displaying fields based on the file type
* Added a new field, **Quote character**, to use an enclosing character
* Reorganised fields to make the setup form more intuitive
* Removed **Infer** as an option from the **File Type** field
* Removed the **Enable Advanced Options** toggle
* Changed the **Null Sequence** field to a toggle
* For the **Delimiter character(s)** field, we now use `,` as the default value
* For the **Line Separator** field, we now use `\n` as the default value

For more information, see our [setup instructions](/docs/connectors/files/azure-blob-storage/setup-guide-new) and [REST API configuration](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#azure-blob-storage).

We are gradually rolling out these changes to all existing connectors.

### HubSpot

We have added a new field, **Historical sync time frame**, to the connector setup form. This allows you to select how many months' worth of historical data you want to sync. For an existing connector, you can edit the connection details and set the time frame value. For more information, see our [Historical sync time frame documentation](/docs/connectors/applications/hubspot#historicalsynctimeframe).

We apply the historical sync limit to the following tables only:

* `CUSTOM_EVENT`
* `EMAIL_EVENT`
* `EVENT`

We are gradually rolling out this feature to all connectors.

HubSpot will sunset the [Contact List V1 APIs](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/lists/overview?_ga=2.243837891.712812277.1734367320-1064102016.1716369476) on May 2025. For all connectors created on or after December 13, 2024, we will use the V3 APIs to sync data to the `CONTACT_LIST` and `CONTACT_LIST_MEMBER` tables. For more information, see [Hubspot documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/changelog/upcoming-sunset-v1-lists-api). We are gradually rolling out these changes to all existing connectors.

We have removed the optional **Sync External Activities** toggle from the connector setup form and now sync the `EXTERNAL_ACTIVITY` table if you provide the required scopes for the `/external-activities` endpoint. For more information, see [Pardot documentation](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.pardot_external_activity_parent.htm&type=5).

You must continue to specify the **Set up API rate limit for External Activities** for the `/external-activities` endpoint.

If your schema change handling configuration settings is **Allow all**, we will sync the `EXTERNAL_ACTIVITY` table to your destination.

### Salesforce

We have added a new toggle, **Sync formula fields directly**, to the connector setup form, with a default value of `OFF`. For an existing connector, you can click **Edit connection** in the **Setup** tab and enable or disable the toggle. Previously, this configuration (of syncing formula fields directly) was only possible via [REST API](/docs/rest-api/api-reference/api-configuration/connector-configuration#salesforce).

This toggle allows you to sync formula fields directly. However, to maintain data integrity, we recommend using our [transformation-based approach](https://fivetran.com/docs/connectors/applications/salesforce/formula#transformationssolution) instead. Directly syncing formula fields can lead to data integrity issues, as outlined in the [Sync limitations](/docs/connectors/applications/salesforce/formula#synclimitations) section.
